package postgres

import (
	"context"

	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain"
	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain/repository"
	"github.com/jackc/pgx/v5/pgxpool"
)

// PositionTechRepoPG implements PositionTechRepository.
type PositionTechRepoPG struct {
	Pool *pgxpool.Pool
}

// Replace updates position tech links to exact set.
func (r PositionTechRepoPG) Replace(ctx context.Context, positionID int, techIDs []int) error {
	runner := getRunner(ctx, r.Pool)
	if _, err := runner.Exec(ctx, `DELETE FROM position_tech WHERE position_id=$1`, positionID); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	for _, techID := range techIDs {
		if _, err := runner.Exec(ctx, `INSERT INTO position_tech (position_id, tech_id) VALUES ($1,$2) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING`, positionID, techID); err != nil {
			return mapPgError(err)
		}
	}
	return nil
}

// ListTechs returns technologies linked to the position.
func (r PositionTechRepoPG) ListTechs(ctx context.Context, positionID int) ([]domain.Tech, error) {
	runner := getRunner(ctx, r.Pool)
	rows, err := runner.Query(ctx, `
SELECT t.id, t.label, t.created_at
FROM position_tech pt
JOIN tech t ON t.id = pt.tech_id
WHERE pt.position_id = $1
ORDER BY t.label ASC`, positionID)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	defer rows.Close()

	var techs []domain.Tech
	for rows.Next() {
		var tech domain.Tech
		if err := rows.Scan(&tech.ID, &tech.Label, &tech.CreatedAt); err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		techs = append(techs, tech)
	}
	if err := rows.Err(); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return techs, nil
}

var _ repository.PositionTechRepository = (*PositionTechRepoPG)(nil)
